[거래량·결론]

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($635.54) vs SMA5/20/50($663.66/$687.50/$698.65): Diagnosing short-term and mid-term trend below moving averages.
· Position relative to SMA100/200($697.09/$671.17): Diagnosing weak long-term trend.
· 52-week position (40.8%): Approaching historical low range at current price level.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (47.1→25.1): Entering oversold territory, strengthening downward momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-0.0697→-4.8818): Bearish trend continues, worsening after dead cross.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Lower Band $651.16): Approaching lower band, band width at 10.57% maintained.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($625.21): Below Pivot S1($607.57), based above 52-week low($578.46).
· Swing Resistance ($636.08): Immediately above current price, below Pivot PP($659.20).
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (5-day low $631.23, 20-day low $631.23): Confirming sideways range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (3.51x 5-day average): Decline accompanied by surge in volume, indicating increased selling pressure.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Downtrend): Potential for further decline due to RSI entering oversold and ADX trend formation stage, but short-term rebound possible due to surge in volume. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
